method.description: Gaussian at the 10 post-ReLU positions (stem output + 9 block outputs), plateau schedule, no resolution change.

gaussian.units: pixels of the feature map at the site; the reference levels unchanged, since SVHN is 32x32 like CIFAR-10

source.label: Blur after every ReLU, annealed to zero

notes: transfer preset: not trained, not validated
insertion mapping: input of blocks.2, as in the reference; SVHN is 32x32 so the site runs at 32 and reference_resolution stays 32
schedules, placements and optimizer identical to the CIFAR-10 reference; SVHN is 32x32 so nothing is rescaled
train set cut to 50000 images so updates/epoch match CIFAR-10's 391 (SVHN has 73,257)
normalisation fitted on all 73,257 training images (the pipeline is built before subsetting), while training uses 50000 of them
optimizer swapped from sgd lr 0.005 wd 0.0005 to adamw lr 0.001 wd 0.01; every other decision is this dataset's study unchanged

lr is the textbook value, NOT matched to the SGD recipe's difficulty: SGD lr 0.005 is ~1/20 of a normal rate and is what keeps the control undertrained. Expect less headroom here; read gaps against this column's own control, and rule out a better-optimized baseline before concluding the optimizer broke the methods.
